author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: The current drawing was a symmetric bottle shape with loops, identical to the drooping-wing bee, and it read as a vase or a robot. There was no head, no stripes and no stinger. Redrawn after the reference as a bee seen from above: a round head with two antennae, a domed body with two stripes ending in a pointed stinger, and a wing spread out to each side.
omissions: The legs and the separate thorax were dropped: no 8-unit room.
